description: Verify that Subscribe → multi-entry SD (Stop+Subscribe) → DUT Acks both Subscribes
approach:
[Objective]
SD entry combination: Stop entry followed by Subscribe entry in the same SD message — DUT processes both.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Subscribe → Ack.
3. Multi-entry SD (StopSubscribe + new Subscribe).
4. Observation: DUT Acks the new Subscribe.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.
